source_caption_text:
The way everyone stood up to applaud Ye when he came out at the Yeezy fashion show 🙏🐐❤️

Via: @n3onsingh 

The crowd got on its feet as Ye walked out to close his YEEZY Season 01 show in Los Angeles last night 👏🐐

It was YEEZY’s first fashion show since 2022, and the setup looked nothing like a traditional runway. Models circled a giant white mound in mostly monochrome looks, Nettspend walked in the show, and what sounded like unreleased Ye music played during the presentation.

Kid Cudi, Big Sean, and 2 Chainz were among the guests. After four years away from the runway, Ye closed the night with a standing ovation.

What caught your attention more: the collection or the music? 👀
